title: Hoshino Ichika — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Phew... Thank goodness I managed to get to the school store before it got too crowded.)
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Welcome back, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami? Oh, Kohane, you're here too.
Were you two waiting for me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. We thought it'd be nice to have lunch together now that we're in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, since it's so nice out, why don't we have lunch in the courtyard...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Kohane
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel that the three of us have never really had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But we'll probably be doing this a lot more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really looking forward to getting to know you two better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Ichika, are you having yakisoba buns for lunch again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I just can't get enough of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see you eating them all the time.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really surprised the first time I saw you have one as an entree and one on the side...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you were...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm used to it now, but that also surprised me the first time I saw you doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, it's not good to only have those. You really should try to get a better mix of meats and vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm also a little worried.
Would you like some of my broccoli?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here, I'll share some of my tomatoes with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, is it that weird to have yakisoba buns without anything else on the side...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haruka sort of said the same thing when I had lunch with her for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, are you only having yakisoba buns for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She basically had the same reaction as you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I was a little surprised.
But I don't think it's weird or anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
I mean, there's nothing wrong with having what you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Honami, you sort of do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember when you went out to buy apple pies the other day? Didn't you say that you bought twenty and ate all of them by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, twenty...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, it's not like I had them all in one day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I can't do that with any type of food. Apple pies just happen to have a special place in my heart...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, twenty's pretty astounding...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... All this talk of yakisoba buns and apple pies is making my stomach feel full for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too... I've hardly touched my lunch, but I feel like I've already had a full meal.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can still eat... More to the point, I'm going to eat these. They're yakisoba buns, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd probably say the same thing if I were having apple pies for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess we all love what we love.
